## Engineering Specialties
- **Distributed Systems & Protocols**: P2P data synchronization, WebRTC DataChannels, local mesh radar, sub-second telemetry.
- **Languages**: Go (Golang), Java, C / C++, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL.
- **Frontend & Product UI**: Modern React, Next.js, high-density terminals, Tailwind-level CSS craftsmanship.
- **Enterprise Platforms**: Oracle BRM (Billing & Revenue Management), high-throughput transactional backends, e-invoicing pipelines.
- **Databases & Tooling**: PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, Redis, Git, Linux daemons, SSH/SFTP clients.

## Key Projects
1. **Flux** (https://kunaljha.online/?project=flux)
   - Zero-install, cross-platform nearby P2P file sharing over WebRTC DataChannels and local mesh radar.
   - Built in Go with direct-to-disk streaming and incremental SHA-256 verification.
2. **NexTerm** (https://kunaljha.online/?project=nexterm)
   - Cross-platform desktop SSH client, terminal emulator, SFTP browser, and remote infrastructure workspace.
3. **SentriX** (https://kunaljha.online/?project=sentrix)
   - Sub-second infrastructure fleet telemetry & anomaly detection engine. Released at v1.2.0 on GitHub.
4. **SpendWise** (https://kunaljha.online/?project=spendwise)
   - Personal finance management platform with algorithmic cash flow modeling and investment analytics.
5. **Billing Operations Portal** (https://kunaljha.online/?project=billing-operations-portal)
   - Enterprise billing and invoicing self-service dashboard with Oracle BRM and automated tax compliance.
